mechanism.mechanism: The architecture exploits the phenomenon of vortex shedding near the impeller vane leading edges, which can be mitigated by introducing a controlled vortex generator to disrupt the cavitation bubble formation.
mechanism.intervention: Introduce a novel, patented vortex generator (VG) design, comprising a series of micro-scale, spiral-shaped vanes integrated into the impeller vane leading edges. The VG design will be optimized using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations to minimize energy losses while maximizing cavitation suppression.
mechanism.expected_effect: The expected effect is a 30% reduction in cavitation bubble collapse near the impeller vane leading edges, resulting in a 20% increase in vane life and a 15% improvement in head delivery at off-design flow conditions.
